{{Quote|One day I hope I can help people like he does--like you do.|Jesha Narlock, on her father and the Commander|<ref name="Dad" />}}
'''Jesha Narlock''' was a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] in [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] service during the [[third Galactic War]]. Jesha Narlock's [[Parent/Legends|father]] [[Dol Narlock]] served as an inspiration for Jesha and was the reason why Jesha decided to join the service.<ref name="Dad" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jesha Narlock first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]''. In the Republic storyline, Jesha sent a message to the [[Alliance Commander]] to thank the Commander for saving Jesha's father after the events on [[Mek-Sha]].<ref name="Dad" />
